name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year to small and marginal farmer families across India, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into bank accounts.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer to bank account
applicationProcess: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Submit Aadhaar card, bank account details, and land records
Registration can also be done online at pmkisan.gov.in
Verification done by state and district officials

name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana
nameHindi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
description: Health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization, covering over 10 crore poor and vulnerable families.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year
No restriction on family size or age
applicationProcess: Check eligibility on pmjay.gov.in or by calling 14555
Visit nearest empanelled hospital or CSC
Show Aadhaar card for identity verification
Ayushman card is issued on the spot

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Gramin
description: Financial assistance to rural households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses to construct pucca houses with basic amenities.
benefits: 90 person-days of unskilled labour under MGNREGS
LPG connection under PM Ujjwala Yojana
applicationProcess: Beneficiary list prepared from SECC 2011 data
Visit gram panchayat to check if your name is on the list
Apply through Awaas+ app or gram panchayat
Funds released in installments directly to bank account

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban
description: Housing for All mission providing interest subsidy and financial assistance to urban poor for construction or purchase of pucca houses.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

exclusions: existing pucca house owners anywhere in India

benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on home loans
Central assistance of ₹1.5 lakh for EWS/LIG
Subsidy on loan up to ₹6 lakh for EWS/LIG
Subsidy on loan up to ₹9 lakh for MIG-I
Subsidy on loan up to ₹12 lakh for MIG-II
applicationProcess: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in
Visit nearest bank or housing finance company
Apply through CSC or urban local body office
Submit income and housing documents

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small savings scheme for the girl child offering high interest rates and tax benefits, aimed at securing education and marriage expenses.

eligibilityCriteria.maxAccounts: 2 per family (3 in case of twins)

benefits: Interest rate of 8.2% per annum (revised quarterly)
Tax deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 lakh
Partial withdrawal allowed after girl turns 18
applicationProcess: Visit nearest post office or authorized bank
Fill SSY account opening form
Submit girl child's birth certificate and guardian's ID
Minimum deposit of ₹250 to open account

name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up micro enterprises in non-farm sector, providing employment to unemployed youth and traditional artisans.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

eligibilityCriteria.educationForLargeProjects: VIII pass for projects above ₹10 lakh (manufacturing) and ₹5 lakh (service)
exclusions: those who received government subsidy before

benefits: 25% subsidy for general category in urban areas
Maximum project cost ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) and ₹20 lakh (service)
Bank provides 90% of project cost as loan
applicationProcess: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal
Application reviewed by KVIC/KVIB/DIC
Interview and project selection by task force committee
Bank sanctions loan after committee approval
Subsidy disbursed directly to bank

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises through three loan products — Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun.
benefits: No processing fee for Shishu loans
MUDRA card for working capital needs
Flexible repayment tenure up to 5 years
applicationProcess: Visit nearest bank, MFI, or NBFC
Fill loan application form
Submit business plan and KYC documents
Loan sanctioned based on credit assessment

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Provides free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line households to replace unclean cooking fuels and protect health.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefits: Free LPG connection with first refill free
applicationProcess: Visit nearest LPG distributor
Fill KYC form (Form 1 and Form 2)
Submit BPL certificate or SECC data proof
Connection issued within 7 days of verification

name: National Scholarship Portal - Central Schemes
description: Single portal for multiple central government scholarships for SC, ST, OBC, minority, and meritorious students from pre-matric to PhD level.
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

eligibilityCriteria.incomeLimit: varies by scheme (generally up to ₹2.5 lakh per annum)

benefits: Scholarship amount varies by scheme and level
Top class education: full fees + living expenses
Direct transfer to student bank account
applicationProcess: Register at scholarships.gov.in
Select applicable scholarship scheme
Fill application with academic and income details
Upload required documents
Submit before deadline and track status online

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accidental death and disability insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh cover at a premium of just ₹20 per year for bank account holders.
applicationProcess: Visit your bank branch or apply via net banking
Fill enrollment form for PMSBY
Give consent for auto-debit of ₹20 premium
Coverage starts immediately upon enrollment

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Life insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh cover for death due to any reason at a premium of ₹436 per year for bank account holders aged 18-50.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life cover for death due to any reason
applicationProcess: Visit your bank branch or apply via net banking/mobile app
Fill enrollment form for PMJJBY
Give consent for auto-debit of ₹436 premium
Coverage starts from date of enrollment

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Pension scheme for unorganized sector workers guaranteeing monthly pension of ₹1,000-₹5,000 after age 60 based on contribution amount.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after 60
Government co-contribution of 50% or ₹1,000/year for 5 years (for eligible subscribers)
Nominee receives corpus on subscriber's death
Spouse continues pension or receives corpus
applicationProcess: Visit your bank branch
Fill APY enrollment form
Provide Aadhaar and mobile number
Choose pension amount (₹1k/2k/3k/4k/5k)
Auto-debit set up from bank account

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
nameHindi: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना
description: Guarantees 100 days of unskilled wage employment per year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

eligibilityCriteria.willingness: willing to do unskilled manual work
eligibilityCriteria.registration: household must be registered with gram panchayat

benefits: 100 days of guaranteed employment per household per year
Wages paid as per state minimum wage rates
Unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days
Work site facilities: crèche, first aid, shade, water
applicationProcess: Register household at gram panchayat with photo ID
Job card issued within 15 days
Apply for work at gram panchayat in writing
Work must be allocated within 15 days of application
Wages paid within 15 days of work completion

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: Skill development scheme to enable youth to take up industry-relevant skill training and earn better livelihoods through certified courses.
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Free skill training in 300+ job roles
applicationProcess: Register at pmkvyofficial.org or skill india portal
Choose training center and course
Attend training (duration varies by course)
Appear for assessment
Receive certificate and reward amount

name: Stand Up India
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.

eligibilityCriteria.nonIndividual: 51% shareholding by SC/ST or woman entrepreneur

benefits: Composite loan of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore
applicationProcess: Apply at standupmitra.in or visit bank branch
Submit business plan and project report
Bank conducts due diligence
Loan sanctioned and disbursed in tranches

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
description: Provides free food grains (5 kg per person per month) to over 80 crore NFSA beneficiaries under Antyodaya Anna Yojana and Priority Household categories.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
benefits: 5 kg free food grains per person per month
Rice, wheat, or coarse grains as per availability
applicationProcess: Eligibility determined by state government
Apply for ration card at nearest ration office or online
State verifies income and family details
Ration card issued and linked to Aadhaar
Collect grains monthly from fair price shop

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
description: Addresses declining child sex ratio and promotes welfare and education of the girl child through a multi-sectoral campaign across all districts.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

eligibilityCriteria.geographic: all districts of India with focus on low CSR districts

benefits: Scholarships and incentives for girl's education
applicationProcess: Contact nearest Anganwadi center
Register girl child at birth with local authorities
Benefits linked to school enrollment and attendance
Contact district Women and Child Development office

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Financial inclusion program ensuring access to financial services — banking, savings, credit, insurance, and pension — to the unbanked population.
benefits: RuPay debit card with ₹2 lakh accident insurance
Life cover of ₹30,000 for accounts opened before Jan 2015
Access to micro-insurance and pension products
applicationProcess: Visit nearest bank branch or BC agent
Fill account opening form
Submit Aadhaar or other simplified KYC document
Account opened same day in most cases
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card (or any one of: voter ID, driving license, NREGA job card, letter from gazetted officer)

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme
description: Provides technical training to engineering graduates, diploma holders, and ITI pass-outs through on-the-job training in industries.
applicationProcess: Register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
Search for apprenticeship openings by location and trade
Apply to establishments
Appear for interview/selection
Sign apprenticeship contract

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss due to unforeseen events like natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

eligibilityCriteria.cropTypes: all food crops, oilseeds, annual commercial/horticultural crops
eligibilityCriteria.loanees: compulsory for farmers with KCC loans

benefits: Premium as low as 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops
5% premium for commercial and horticultural crops
Full insured sum without upper limit on government subsidy
Quick claim settlement via remote sensing and technology
applicationProcess: Apply at nearest bank, CSC, or insurance company office
Can apply online at pmfby.gov.in
Enrollment must be done before cutoff date for each season
Submit crop sowing details and land records

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
nameHindi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्या योजना
description: Placement-linked skill training program for rural youth from BPL families to enhance their employability and place them in regular jobs.

eligibilityCriteria.family: BPL or MGNREGS job card holder family

benefits: Free residential and non-residential skill training
applicationProcess: Contact nearest DDU-GKY training partner
Register with gram panchayat or block office
Undergo training (3-12 months)
Assessment and certification
Placement by training partner

name: PM SVANidhi - PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Provides affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods that were adversely affected due to COVID-19 pandemic.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

eligibilityCriteria.surveyStatus: identified in ULB-led survey or recommended by ULB/TVC

benefits: Enhanced loan of ₹20,000 on timely repayment
Cash-back incentive for digital transactions up to ₹1,200/year
applicationProcess: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in
Visit nearest CSC or lending institution
Submit vendor certificate or letter of recommendation
Loan disbursed within 30 days

name: e-Shram Portal - Unorganized Workers Registration
description: National database of unorganized workers to extend social security benefits, providing a universal account number and e-Shram card for accessing government schemes.
benefits: e-Shram card with Universal Account Number (UAN)
Platform for future social security benefits
applicationProcess: Register at eshram.gov.in or nearest CSC
Enter Aadhaar number and OTP
Fill occupation, bank, and family details
e-Shram card generated instantly

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Holistic support to artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools, covering 18 traditional trades including carpenter, blacksmith, potter, weaver, and more.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Recognition via PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card
Collateral-free loan up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest
Digital transaction incentive and marketing support
applicationProcess: Register at pmvishwakarma.gov.in via CSC
Verification by gram panchayat and district officials
Skill training at designated training center
Loan applied through partner banks after training

name: National Social Assistance Programme
description: Provides financial assistance to elderly, widows, disabled persons, and bereaved families below poverty line through five sub-schemes.
benefits: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension: ₹200-₹500/month
National Family Benefit: ₹20,000 lump sum on death of breadwinner
Annapurna: 10 kg free food grains/month for eligible elderly
applicationProcess: Apply at gram panchayat or block development office
Submit application with BPL and category proof
Verification by district social welfare officer
Pension credited directly to bank account monthly
requiredDocuments: Death certificate of husband (for widow pension)

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
description: Provides financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization.

eligibilityCriteria.incorporationAge: not more than 2 years at time of application
eligibilityCriteria.stage: early stage with business idea or PoC
eligibilityCriteria.fundingHistory: not received more than ₹10 lakh in grants from other central/state schemes
exclusions: startups with financial assistance from SEBI-registered funds

benefits: Up to ₹20 lakh for proof of concept, prototype, product trials
Up to ₹50 lakh for market entry and commercialization (as convertible debentures or debt)
applicationProcess: Apply at seedfund.startupindia.gov.in
Select incubator from approved list
Submit startup details, business plan, and funding requirement
Incubator committee evaluates application
Funds disbursed through incubator
